text:
incidents-bot: P1 ALERT — GPU pool p-prod-eu-2 memory pressure + queue growth detected. autoscaler stalled on scale-out (hit max_nodes), request queue > 5k. Affected models: manta-2.1 (recent rollout). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure

oncall-amanda: I'm paged, jumping in. looking at graphs now.

oncall-amanda: queue length spiked at 22:04 UTC, 95pct latency 8.3s, error rate (5xx) up to 18% from p-prod-eu-2 replicas.

infra-raj: I see autoscaler attempted 3 scale-outs but got limited by pool quota. current pool size 48, max_nodes configured 48.

eng-runtime-maya: I pulled a heap profile from a sample replica: memory RSS shows sustained growth across requests. Not typical — looks like context-index objects are not being evicted quickly.

eng-runtime-maya: hypothesis: manta-2.1 rollout increased default context window + tokenizer change which produces bigger KV entries -> per-request memory delta ~+1.7x. That pushes replicas to >90% mem and slows scheduling, causing queueing.

infra-raj: immediate actions I'm running: temporarily increase pool max to 80 and trigger scale-out. running command:
```
infra-cli pool update --name p-prod-eu-2 --max-nodes 80 --reason "emergency roll-backstop: manta-2.1 memory"
infra-cli pool scale --name p-prod-eu-2 --target-nodes 70
```

oncall-amanda: pausing manta-2.1 rollout now (canary halted). command:
```
deployctl rollout pause --model manta-2.1
```

support-jordan: customer impact — we have elevated errors from 3 paying tenants: acme-corp (latency spikes, some 502s), safehealth (timeouts), finpipe (rate-limited by client). CS is contacting them, sending status updates.

eng-runtime-maya: mitigation suggestions:
- pause rollout (done)
- route new traffic to fallback model manta-2.0-slim (lower memory profile)
- enable aggressive KV eviction on warm replicas
- temporarily lower default max_context to 2048 for manta-2.1 if rollback isn't immediate

infra-raj: routing switch applied for 10% traffic -> manta-2.0-slim as safety. command used:
```
routerctl traffic-split --model manta --weight "manta-2.1:90,manta-2.0-slim:10"
```

eng-runtime-maya: also applied a KV eviction threshold on the runtime via feature-flag:
```
runtime-flag set evict.kv_threshold=0.65 --scope pool:p-prod-eu-2
```
This prunes cached context earlier to relieve memory pressure; should help while scale completes.

sre-lee: monitoring: after scale request and eviction flag, queue dropped from 5.2k -> 1.1k in ~7 minutes, 5xxs down to 6%. Latency 95pct trending down to 3.2s.

support-jordan: will send updated customer note: "We have paused the rollout and are routing to a fallback model; you may see degraded latency while we finish remediation."

pm-elaine: timeline for customers — any ETA on when we can fully restore normal service?

infra-raj: scaling to 70 nodes should be mostly complete within 10–12 minutes; then autoscaler config will be reviewed. If memory pressure persists, we'll keep the rollback route.

eng-runtime-maya: root-cause short note from runtime side: manta-2.1 introduced a tokenization change that emits longer prefix tokens for a subset of inputs. That increases KV index size and also touches a previously-unused dense metadata slab causing slower GC. We'll prepare a v2.1-hotfix with smaller token block generation and enable it after tests.

oncall-amanda: will stay on until handoff. I've documented current mitigations in incident doc: https://redwood/incidents/2293456789

incidents-bot: NOTE — autoscaler config change required: lower cooldown from 300s -> 120s during emergency; set max_nodes back to previous after stabilizing.

infra-raj: applied cooldown tweak:
```
autoscaler update --pool p-prod-eu-2 --scale-cooldown 120
```

eng-runtime-maya: also enabling an emergency request-throttle on the model route to reduce load while scale finishes:
```
ratelimitctl set --route /v1/models/manta-2.1 --requests-per-sec 25
```

support-jordan: customers have acknowledged the update; one asked for ETA on a rollback vs hotfix.

oncall-amanda: summary for handoff -> Day on-call (sre-lee):
- root cause: manta-2.1 rollout increased per-request memory via tokenizer/context growth
- current state: rollout paused, 10% traffic to fallback, pool scaled to 70 nodes, KV eviction flag on, throttles in place
- impact: reduced errors and queue length but some tenants still see intermittent 5xx/latency
- next steps: monitor memory RSS across pool, validate hotfix patch from runtime team, coordinate rollback if pressure resurfaces

noncall-amanda: handing off to @sre-lee, I'm offline in ~30m but reachable on pager for emergencies. :handoff: 

sre-lee: taking handoff. acknowledged. I'll keep the throttles in place and watch for mem RSS. If we see >85% mem on >10% replicas after 30m we will revert manta-2.1 fully.

eng-runtime-maya: working on hotfix branch now, aim to have tested image in 60–90m.
